subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. The selected videos are highly relevant, from reputable educational channels, and have strong viewership, ensuring both quality and peer validation. For Arabic, some topics had fewer eligible candidates, often due to low view counts, but suitable academic lectures were found for all.

coverage.note: Most other candidates failed the view count gate.
